claims.hypothesis: AGN contribution varies with merger stage
claims.experiment: Median nuclear SEDs binned by interaction class
claims.result: Low AGN contribution in early-stage mergers, enhanced in late and post-merger stages
claims.finding: AGN fraction enhanced in later stages

evidence.quote: the AGN fraction (fraction of AGN infrared luminosity to total infrared luminosity) appears enhanced in the late- and post-merger stages compared to early-stage mergers

claims.hypothesis: Nuclear X-ray properties differ from global
claims.experiment: Compared nuclear L_SX, L_HX and HR with global values
claims.result: Nuclear regions have higher hardness ratios than hosts
claims.finding: Hard X-ray emission is more nucleated

evidence.quote: nuclear regions have higher X-ray hardness ratios than the host galaxies globally among both the AGN and non-AGN population

limitations_admitted.value: Lack of high-resolution mid- to far-infrared data limits reliability of derived properties; near-IR PSFs unresolved for some.

evidence.quote: their reliability is primarily limited by the lack of high-resolution mid- to far-infrared data

referee_caveats_inferred: Many mid/far-IR points are upper limits so AGN fractions are degenerate
ALMA excess emission and low-frequency fit issues
Stage 5-6 AGN trend not clearly significant
